name: ffxiv-leve-and-roulette-planner
description: Static web app for FFXIV players to plan daily roulettes, leve allowances, and weekly goals. Checklists reset on configurable game reset times. localStorage, accessible UI, tested reset-time logic.

scripts.start: echo 'Open index.html in your browser, or serve this folder with any static server (e.g. python3 -m http.server).'
